 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VIBHU BAKHRU  HON'BLE MS. JUSTICE TARA VITASTA GANJU  ORDER % 07.05.2024 1.

The petitioners have filed the present petition, inter alia, praying that directions be issued to respondent no. 1 to decide the petitioners' application under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereafter the LA Act) in accordance with law.

2. The petitioners claim that they have received a compensation in respect of the subject land which was acquired, in terms of the order dated 28.03.2017 passed by the learned Additional District Judge.
The petitioners had not filed a reference under Section 18 of the LA Act.
However, certain other "interested persons" had filed a reference under Section 18 of the LA This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 13/05/2024 at 20:37:52 Act seeking an enhancement of the compensation awarded, which was decided on 04.04.2022 by the learned Additional District Judge.

sentences.text: 1 3. In view of the above, the petitioners have filed an application seeking enhancement of the compensation under Section 28A of the LA Act claiming parity with the other "interested persons".

The petitioners' grievance is that their application has not been decided.
4.
The present petition was listed on 29.11.2023 and the learned counsel appearing for the LAC had sought time to obtain instructions.
A similar request is made today as well.
He states that formal notice has not been issued.
5. Issue notice.
The learned counsel for the respondents accepts notice.
6. The counter-affidavit be filed within a period of two weeks from date.
Rejoinder, if any, be filed before the next date of hearing.

7. List on 30.07.2024.
VIBHU BAKHRU, J TARA VITASTA GANJU, J MAY 07, 2024/r
